blocks.text: Fiza ki chaar alag tahein hain, jo barhti oonchai ke saath darja hararat ki tabdeeli se tay hoti hain (Figure 14.1).

blocks.alt: Neeche daen zameen ka gol hissa aur oopar neela aasman. Zameen ke qareeb se ek lambi tirchhi lakeer oopar jati hai jise chaar ishara-lakeerein kaatti hain jo oonchai ko tah ke naam se jorti hain: 0-12 km Troposphere, 12-50 km Stratosphere, 50-85 km Mesosphere aur 85-600 km Thermosphere.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.1: Fiza ki tahein (kitab ki Figure 14.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeche se oopar chaar tahein hain: troposphere (0-12 km, mausam isi mein), stratosphere (12-50 km, ozone ki teh), mesosphere (50-85 km, sab se thandi) aur thermosphere (85-600 km). Kitab ki shakal mein mesosphere '50-80 km' aur thermosphere '80-600 km' chhapa hai, jabke kitab ka apna text 85 km kehta hai; hamare khaake mein text ke mutabiq 50-85 km aur 85-600 km likha hai.

items: Troposphere: sab se neechi tah, 12 km tak phaili hui. Is mein sab bari gases hain, nitrogen, oxygen, carbon dioxide waghaira; darja hararat 17 degrees C se -58 degrees C tak baqaida ghat-ta hai. Yeh sab se ghani tah hai, aur woh tah jis mein barish, bijli aur toofan jaise bare waqiat hote hain.

Stratosphere: troposphere ke oopar, zameen ki satah se 12 se 50 km oopar; darja hararat -58 degrees C se -2 degrees C tak barhta hai. Is tak pohnchne wali ultraviolet shuaon ke mutabiq ise teen ilaqon mein baanta ja sakta hai. Oopri tah mein ozone zyada energy wali ultraviolet shuaein jazb kar ke monatomic aur diatomic oxygen mein toot jati hai, O3 se O2 + O. Darmiyani stratosphere se kam ultraviolet guzarti hai, aur yahan monatomic aur diatomic oxygen dobara mil kar exothermic reaction mein ozone banati hain, O2 + O se O3, jis se ozone ki tah banti hai. Neechi stratosphere ko bohat kam ultraviolet milti hai, to monatomic oxygen nahi milti aur ozone nahi banti.
Mesosphere: zameen se taqreeban 50 se 85 km; darja hararat oonchai ke saath -2 degrees C se -93 degrees C tak girta hai, aur fiza ka sab se thanda ilaqa isi tah mein hai.

Thermosphere: satah se 85 km se 600 km oopar; darja hararat oonchai ke saath barhta hai kyunke taqatwar ultraviolet aur X-rays jazb hoti hain; oopri thermosphere mein yeh 500 degrees C se 2000 degrees C ya zyada ho sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Stratosphere mein ozone banne aur ghatne ke muadle dein, aur troposphere aur stratosphere ke darja hararat ke rujhanat wazeh karein (Quick Check 14.1b, c; exercise Q.2c).
blocks.explanation: Oopri stratosphere mein kami: O3 ultraviolet se O2 + O deti hai; darmiyani stratosphere mein banna: O2 + O se O3 (exothermic). Troposphere neeche se garam zameen se garam hoti hai, to oonchai ke saath thandi hoti hai; stratosphere apne andar se garam hoti hai kyunke us ki ozone ultraviolet shuaein jazb karti hai aur dobara milna garmi chhorta hai, to us ka darja hararat oonchai ke saath barhta hai.

items: Darja hararat ke rujhan se chaar tahein: troposphere 0-12 km (-58 degrees C tak thandi, mausam, sab se ghani); stratosphere 12-50 km (-2 degrees C tak garam; ozone: O3 se O2 + O, O2 + O se O3); mesosphere 50-85 km (sab se thandi, -93 degrees C); thermosphere 85-600 km (500-2000 degrees C, UV aur X-rays jazb).
